budget.written: Written before the first query (pl-62 Build 7, 2026-10-24), committed with the re-measure and before any search; the web check runs later in a separate general-purpose agent, which records each key's planned first query in the ticket's Log before it searches, the way pl-58's d3ca4190 and pl-60's pre-registration did. The stratum is `food`'s named premises alone (`STRATUM_SPECIALISTS` in invention.ts), because pl-62 changed `food` only. The rubric is pl-57's: a place that came back under the first query it was given is `exists`, `exists-elsewhere` or `closed` on that evidence, each key judged from its own locality; `not-found` only after every query below. `not-found` means the search did not find it, never that it does not exist. Keys that name one real-world entity share one first query, and so one object; where pl-57, pl-58 or pl-60 searched the same entity its first query is reused verbatim. Spend: one first query per object (up to 40, or all of them if fewer), up to two further queries for a key whose own locality the object's results do not settle, and the three queries below for any key heading to `not-found`; a cap of 90 queries and 20 page fetches in all, and the checks stop and are reported if the cap is reached. Search tool: WebSearch, with WebFetch only to read a result page; both from a general-purpose agent, after the owner opens the firewall. A key whose name equals a find the run handed `food` is still searched: a map entry is not proof the premises is open, and the join count is reported apart.
queriesBeforeNotFound: 1. the name with its locality, as the candidate wrote them
2. the name alone, in quotation marks
3. the name in the local language (French for Québec, Italian for Rome and Trieste, German for Vienna, Slovene for Ljubljana, Spanish for Cuba, Mexico and the Dominican Republic)

plus: the OSM result recorded for this place in pl-56 (tools/planner/api/test/fixtures/live/hours-coverage/2026-10-17.json), where pl-56 read the place; pl-56 read only pl-57's 1,019 places, so most of this stratum's keys have no row
budget.osm: Copied by the harness from pl-56's hours-coverage record for a checked key it has a row for; null for the keys pl-56 never read. A place pl-56 located is not thereby real.
